_about: Tunable layout values (parameters), read by canvas.py and notes.py. Fixed sizes of the frontend (title bar height, Reroute size, etc.) do not belong here.

V_GAP.meaning: Gap between nodes stacked in the same column (from the bottom of the upper node to the top of the lower node's title bar)

H_GAP.meaning: Gap between columns (from the right edge of the left column to the left edge of the right column)

RAIL_GAP.source: Measured in a hand-made layout (z-image t2i detail): distance between the positive and negative rails (the smaller of 56 and 58)

GROUP_PAD_LEFT.meaning: From a group's left edge to the left edge of its leftmost node
GROUP_PAD_LEFT.source: Hand-made layouts (116 groups in 44 workflows). Median 17.4

GROUP_PAD_RIGHT.meaning: From the right edge of the rightmost node inside to the group's right edge
GROUP_PAD_RIGHT.source: Hand-made layouts (116 groups in 44 workflows). Median 21.1

GROUP_PAD_TOP.meaning: From a group's top edge (including its title) to the top of the title bar of its topmost node
GROUP_PAD_TOP.source: Hand-made layouts (116 groups in 44 workflows). Lower quartile 55.2 (groups are often given equal heights, which inflates the median, so the tighter side is taken)

GROUP_PAD_BOTTOM.meaning: From the bottom of the lowest node inside to the group's bottom edge
GROUP_PAD_BOTTOM.source: Hand-made layouts (116 groups in 44 workflows). Lower quartile 28.6 (same reason)
